description: Earthquake, wildfire, outage, evacuation, insurance, pet, document, and supply planning for a household.
notes: Shared kit was not present at build time; a minimal local Kit fallback is inlined.

notes.note: One living page the family follows at 2am beats a binder nobody reads — true. But household prep is bought in fear spikes (after the neighbor's fire), not as a $5/mo subscription; retention will crater between disasters. The affiliate-on-supplies line is the honest business model here.
Tabs switch; go-bag check-off toggles; zero errors.

notes.change: New Renewals tab: 7 timed upkeep items (water rotation, detector batteries, insurance, quake rider...) with due-date badges; Mark done rolls the date forward, persisted.
